title: The Oldest Human Fossil Outside Africa Was Found in Arabia
description: A 90,000‑year‑old finger bone uncovered in the Nefud Desert rewrites the timeline of early human migration. It proves modern humans reached Arabia far earlier than previously believed.
narration: ARABIAN PENINSULA IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture the first modern humans outside Africa showing up in Europe tens of thousands of years later. In fact, they were already in Arabia 90,000 years ago — far earlier than previously thought in prehistory. A fossilized Homo sapiens finger bone from Al Wusta in the Nefud Desert was dated to roughly 90 kiloyears, the oldest modern human fossil discovered outside Africa and the Levant, and suggests early Arabian settlement in the Arabian Peninsula. Arabia hosted humanity’s move out of Africa
